Switching from Android to iPhone is simple.
Switching from Android to iPhone is simple.
Transfer your data in a few easy steps.

Simply download the Move to iOS app on your Android phone to securely transfer the stuff you care about most to your iPhone — contacts, messages, WhatsApp content, photos, videos, email accounts, favorite apps, call history, and more.
Learn more about the Move to iOS app

Messages lets you reply with a quick emoji, create Memoji, and pay a friend for pizza. RCS (Rich Communication Services) messaging brings richer media and delivery and read receipts for those who don’t use iMessage. * And you can keep your conversations going on apps such as WhatsApp and WeChat.

Apple engineers design our hardware and software together for a totally seamless experience. Want to connect your new AirPods to your iPhone? It’s a simple one‑tap setup. Want to share photos or contacts with friends nearby? AirDrop lists their names onscreen, so you can choose with a tap.
Help is just a call or chat away.

There are lots of ways to reach someone if you have questions. Call a Specialist, chat with someone online, go into an Apple Store, or use the Apple Support app. And the Tips app will help you get the most out of your iPhone over time.
iPhone holds its value longer than other smartphones.
iPhone holds its value longer than other smartphones.

iPhone is protected by Ceramic Shield, which is tougher than any smartphone glass or glass ceramic. Our latest iPhone models have Ceramic Shield 2 on the front, with better scratch resistance, 1 and Ceramic Shield on the back for added durability. Little spill? No biggie — iPhone stands up to splashes from everyday liquids like water, coffee, and soda. 2
Regular iOS updates keep your iPhone feeling new for years to come. Just turn on automatic updates, and your iPhone stays current with the latest features and security.

The vapor-cooled A20 Pro chip is the most powerful and efficient chip ever in an iPhone. And because it’s purpose-built for AI, with Neural Accelerators and a new Dual 16-core Neural Engine, A20 Pro supercharges everything from image generation to intelligent camera features.
Picture your best photos and videos.
Picture your best photos and videos.

The advanced cameras in iPhone automatically capture phenomenal photos with great detail and color. And on iPhone Duo, Smart Take uses on-device AI to detect when people are posed and automatically takes the picture.

With variable aperture on the 48MP Fusion Main camera, iPhone 18 Pro offers our best-ever camera system for pros and creators. It automatically adjusts depth of field for exceptional low-light photos and video. And with new Pro controls and Photographic Styles 3 to adjust texture and grain, you’ll have even more creative range.

Get pro-level videos using 4K 120 fps Dolby Vision on iPhone Duo and the latest Pro models. Use Action mode to steady shaky scenes as you shoot. Remove unwanted background noise from voices and music with Audio Mix. Add Cinematic mode effects, even after you shoot. Quickly access camera tools with Camera Control. And with the Center Stage front camera, use Dual Capture to record on front and rear cameras simultaneously. 6
Helpful in all the right places.
Helpful in all the right places.

Your AI assistant, Siri AI is powered by Apple Intelligence and is more helpful than ever. 3 Get more done every day with richer answers, natural conversations, and a new, dedicated app. It’s truly helpful AI that’s centered around you and your needs — integrated into your apps, grounded in your context, and private at every step.
Siri AI is rolling out in English. Usage limits may apply.
Start a visual search with the Shutter button.
Siri mode in Camera and Visual Intelligence let you search, ask questions, and take action based on what’s around you with just a tap. 4
Easy-to-use AI editing tools like Spatial Reframing let you adjust a shot after it’s been taken. You can expand your photos with the Extend tool. And remove objects with the enhanced Clean Up tool. 5
Designed with the earth in mind.
Designed with the earth in mind.
We’re significantly expanding the use of key recycled metals in iPhone batteries, magnets, and circuit boards. Case in point: All our batteries are now made from 100 percent recycled cobalt. 7
All iPhone packaging is made of paper that is 100 percent fiber based and can be easily recycled.

When you’re ready to buy a new iPhone, you can trade in your current iPhone or Android device and apply any credit toward your purchase. If your device isn’t eligible for credit, we’ll recycle it for free.
Our disassembly robots — Daisy, Dave, and Taz — recover crucial materials like gold, cobalt, tungsten, and rare earth elements so they can be recycled and used again.
Our stores, offices, and data centers are already carbon neutral. By 2030, we aim to reach carbon neutrality for our global footprint.
Your data. Just where you want it.
Your data. Just where you want it.

Apple Intelligence is integrated into your iPhone through on-device processing. So it’s aware of your personal information without collecting your personal information. With Private Cloud Compute, it can draw on larger, Apple-designed server-based models, running on Apple silicon, to handle more complex requests while protecting your privacy.
The Passwords app makes it easier to access account passwords, passkeys, Wi‑Fi passwords, and two-factor authentication codes stored securely on your device or synced with iCloud Keychain.
Private Browsing in Safari locks browsing windows when they’re not being used, blocks known trackers from loading on pages, and removes tracking added to URLs as you browse.

Leases are provided by Klarna; subject to eligibility and credit approval, including final approval at checkout. To be eligible, you must be a U.S. resident, at least 18 years old (or the legal age in your state), have an accepted credit or debit card, and have an Apple ID. Additional eligibility criteria apply. Device must be in good condition upon return; damage fees may apply. For iPhone only: In order to lease an iPhone, you must select an eligible carrier (but you cannot use a prepaid carrier plan). Upgrades require entering into a new lease and are subject to eligibility and credit approval. Apple Upgrade is not available on refurbished devices or online at the following special stores: Apple Employee Purchase Plan; participating corporate Employee Purchase Programs; Apple at Work for small businesses or enterprises; Government, Education, or Veterans and Military Purchase Programs. * RCS messaging on iPhone is available in specific markets and requires support from your carrier. Check with your carrier for further details. ** Trade‑in values will vary based on the condition, year, and configuration of your eligible trade‑in device. Not all devices are eligible for credit. You must be at least the age of majority to be eligible to trade in for credit or for an Apple Gift Card. Trade‑in value may be applied toward qualifying new device purchase, or added to an Apple Gift Card. Actual value awarded is based on receipt of a qualifying device matching the description provided when estimate was made. Sales tax may be assessed on full value of a new device purchase. In‑store trade‑in requires presentation of a valid photo ID (local law may require saving this information). Offer may not be available in all stores, and may vary between in‑store and online trade‑in. Some stores may have additional requirements. Apple or its trade‑in partners reserve the right to refuse, cancel, or limit quantity of any trade‑in transaction for any reason. More details are available from Apple′s trade‑in partner for trade‑in and recycling of eligible devices. Restrictions and limitations may apply. ◊ Apple Upgrade Lease: This offer is for a consumer lease, not a purchase or loan. Lease provided by Klarna Inc. for 12-, 24-, or 36-month terms. 12- and 36-month terms not available for all device models. Your first monthly payment is due approximately 30 days after device is shipped or available for pickup. Lease approval is subject to eligibility and is based on creditworthiness. Monthly payments are based on the selected device and lease term. For example: For an iPhone 18 Pro 256GB with a purchase price of $1,199 (excluding taxes and any trade-in credit), the typical monthly payment is $34.99 (excluding taxes and any trade-in credit) for a 24-month lease term and $49.99 (excluding taxes and any trade-in credit) for a 12-month lease term. For an Apple Watch Series 12 42mm with a purchase price of $399 (excluding taxes and any trade-in credit), the typical monthly payment is $11.99 (excluding taxes and any trade-in credit) for a 24-month lease term and $21.99 (excluding taxes and any trade-in credit) for a 12-month lease term. For an 11-inch iPad Pro 256GB with a purchase price of $1,199 (excluding taxes and any trade-in credit), the typical monthly payment is $24.99 (excluding taxes and any trade-in credit) for a 36-month lease term and $31.99 (excluding taxes and any trade-in credit) for a 24-month lease term. For a 14-inch MacBook Pro 16GB with a purchase price of $1,999 (excluding taxes and any trade-in credit), the typical monthly payment is $38.99 (excluding taxes and any trade-in credit) for a 36-month lease term and $53.99 (excluding taxes and any trade-in credit) for a 24-month lease term. Switching from Android to iPhone is simple.
Switching from Android to iPhone is simple.
Transfer your data in a few easy steps.

Simply download the Move to iOS app on your Android phone to securely transfer the stuff you care about most to your iPhone — contacts, messages, WhatsApp content, photos, videos, email accounts, favorite apps, call history, and more.
Learn more about the Move to iOS app

Messages lets you reply with a quick emoji, create Memoji, and pay a friend for pizza. RCS (Rich Communication Services) messaging brings richer media and delivery and read receipts for those who don’t use iMessage. * And you can keep your conversations going on apps such as WhatsApp and WeChat.

Apple engineers design our hardware and software together for a totally seamless experience. Want to connect your new AirPods to your iPhone? It’s a simple one‑tap setup. Want to share photos or contacts with friends nearby? AirDrop lists their names onscreen, so you can choose with a tap.
Help is just a call or chat away.

There are lots of ways to reach someone if you have questions. Call a Specialist, chat with someone online, go into an Apple Store, or use the Apple Support app. And the Tips app will help you get the most out of your iPhone over time.
iPhone holds its value longer than other smartphones.
iPhone holds its value longer than other smartphones.

iPhone is protected by Ceramic Shield, which is tougher than any smartphone glass or glass ceramic. Our latest iPhone models have Ceramic Shield 2 on the front, with better scratch resistance, 1 and Ceramic Shield on the back for added durability. Little spill? No biggie — iPhone stands up to splashes from everyday liquids like water, coffee, and soda. 2
Regular iOS updates keep your iPhone feeling new for years to come. Just turn on automatic updates, and your iPhone stays current with the latest features and security.

The vapor-cooled A20 Pro chip is the most powerful and efficient chip ever in an iPhone. And because it’s purpose-built for AI, with Neural Accelerators and a new Dual 16-core Neural Engine, A20 Pro supercharges everything from image generation to intelligent camera features.
Picture your best photos and videos.
Picture your best photos and videos.

The advanced cameras in iPhone automatically capture phenomenal photos with great detail and color. And on iPhone Duo, Smart Take uses on-device AI to detect when people are posed and automatically takes the picture.

With variable aperture on the 48MP Fusion Main camera, iPhone 18 Pro offers our best-ever camera system for pros and creators. It automatically adjusts depth of field for exceptional low-light photos and video. And with new Pro controls and Photographic Styles 3 to adjust texture and grain, you’ll have even more creative range.

Get pro-level videos using 4K 120 fps Dolby Vision on iPhone Duo and the latest Pro models. Use Action mode to steady shaky scenes as you shoot. Remove unwanted background noise from voices and music with Audio Mix. Add Cinematic mode effects, even after you shoot. Quickly access camera tools with Camera Control. And with the Center Stage front camera, use Dual Capture to record on front and rear cameras simultaneously. 6
Helpful in all the right places.
Helpful in all the right places.

Your AI assistant, Siri AI is powered by Apple Intelligence and is more helpful than ever. 3 Get more done every day with richer answers, natural conversations, and a new, dedicated app. It’s truly helpful AI that’s centered around you and your needs — integrated into your apps, grounded in your context, and private at every step.
Siri AI is rolling out in English. Usage limits may apply.
Start a visual search with the Shutter button.
Siri mode in Camera and Visual Intelligence let you search, ask questions, and take action based on what’s around you with just a tap. 4
Easy-to-use AI editing tools like Spatial Reframing let you adjust a shot after it’s been taken. You can expand your photos with the Extend tool. And remove objects with the enhanced Clean Up tool. 5
Designed with the earth in mind.
Designed with the earth in mind.
We’re significantly expanding the use of key recycled metals in iPhone batteries, magnets, and circuit boards. Case in point: All our batteries are now made from 100 percent recycled cobalt. 7
All iPhone packaging is made of paper that is 100 percent fiber based and can be easily recycled.

When you’re ready to buy a new iPhone, you can trade in your current iPhone or Android device and apply any credit toward your purchase. If your device isn’t eligible for credit, we’ll recycle it for free.
Our disassembly robots — Daisy, Dave, and Taz — recover crucial materials like gold, cobalt, tungsten, and rare earth elements so they can be recycled and used again.
Our stores, offices, and data centers are already carbon neutral. By 2030, we aim to reach carbon neutrality for our global footprint.
Your data. Just where you want it.
Your data. Just where you want it.

Apple Intelligence is integrated into your iPhone through on-device processing. So it’s aware of your personal information without collecting your personal information. With Private Cloud Compute, it can draw on larger, Apple-designed server-based models, running on Apple silicon, to handle more complex requests while protecting your privacy.
The Passwords app makes it easier to access account passwords, passkeys, Wi‑Fi passwords, and two-factor authentication codes stored securely on your device or synced with iCloud Keychain.
Private Browsing in Safari locks browsing windows when they’re not being used, blocks known trackers from loading on pages, and removes tracking added to URLs as you browse.

Switching from Android to iPhone is simple.
Switching from Android to iPhone is simple.
Transfer your data in a few easy steps.

Simply download the Move to iOS app on your Android phone to securely transfer the stuff you care about most to your iPhone — contacts, messages, WhatsApp content, photos, videos, email accounts, favorite apps, call history, and more.
Learn more about the Move to iOS app

Messages lets you reply with a quick emoji, create Memoji, and pay a friend for pizza. RCS (Rich Communication Services) messaging brings richer media and delivery and read receipts for those who don’t use iMessage. * And you can keep your conversations going on apps such as WhatsApp and WeChat.

Apple engineers design our hardware and software together for a totally seamless experience. Want to connect your new AirPods to your iPhone? It’s a simple one‑tap setup. Want to share photos or contacts with friends nearby? AirDrop lists their names onscreen, so you can choose with a tap.
Help is just a call or chat away.

There are lots of ways to reach someone if you have questions. Call a Specialist, chat with someone online, go into an Apple Store, or use the Apple Support app. And the Tips app will help you get the most out of your iPhone over time.
iPhone holds its value longer than other smartphones.
iPhone holds its value longer than other smartphones.

iPhone is protected by Ceramic Shield, which is tougher than any smartphone glass or glass ceramic. Our latest iPhone models have Ceramic Shield 2 on the front, with better scratch resistance, 1 and Ceramic Shield on the back for added durability. Little spill? No biggie — iPhone stands up to splashes from everyday liquids like water, coffee, and soda. 2
Regular iOS updates keep your iPhone feeling new for years to come. Just turn on automatic updates, and your iPhone stays current with the latest features and security.

The vapor-cooled A20 Pro chip is the most powerful and efficient chip ever in an iPhone. And because it’s purpose-built for AI, with Neural Accelerators and a new Dual 16-core Neural Engine, A20 Pro supercharges everything from image generation to intelligent camera features.
Picture your best photos and videos.
Picture your best photos and videos.

The advanced cameras in iPhone automatically capture phenomenal photos with great detail and color. And on iPhone Duo, Smart Take uses on-device AI to detect when people are posed and automatically takes the picture.

With variable aperture on the 48MP Fusion Main camera, iPhone 18 Pro offers our best-ever camera system for pros and creators. It automatically adjusts depth of field for exceptional low-light photos and video. And with new Pro controls and Photographic Styles 3 to adjust texture and grain, you’ll have even more creative range.

Get pro-level videos using 4K 120 fps Dolby Vision on iPhone Duo and the latest Pro models. Use Action mode to steady shaky scenes as you shoot. Remove unwanted background noise from voices and music with Audio Mix. Add Cinematic mode effects, even after you shoot. Quickly access camera tools with Camera Control. And with the Center Stage front camera, use Dual Capture to record on front and rear cameras simultaneously. 6
Helpful in all the right places.
Helpful in all the right places.

Your AI assistant, Siri AI is powered by Apple Intelligence and is more helpful than ever. 3 Get more done every day with richer answers, natural conversations, and a new, dedicated app. It’s truly helpful AI that’s centered around you and your needs — integrated into your apps, grounded in your context, and private at every step.
Siri AI is rolling out in English. Usage limits may apply.
Start a visual search with the Shutter button.
Siri mode in Camera and Visual Intelligence let you search, ask questions, and take action based on what’s around you with just a tap. 4
Easy-to-use AI editing tools like Spatial Reframing let you adjust a shot after it’s been taken. You can expand your photos with the Extend tool. And remove objects with the enhanced Clean Up tool. 5
Designed with the earth in mind.
Designed with the earth in mind.
We’re significantly expanding the use of key recycled metals in iPhone batteries, magnets, and circuit boards. Case in point: All our batteries are now made from 100 percent recycled cobalt. 7
All iPhone packaging is made of paper that is 100 percent fiber based and can be easily recycled.

When you’re ready to buy a new iPhone, you can trade in your current iPhone or Android device and apply any credit toward your purchase. If your device isn’t eligible for credit, we’ll recycle it for free.
Our disassembly robots — Daisy, Dave, and Taz — recover crucial materials like gold, cobalt, tungsten, and rare earth elements so they can be recycled and used again.
Our stores, offices, and data centers are already carbon neutral. By 2030, we aim to reach carbon neutrality for our global footprint.
Your data. Just where you want it.
Your data. Just where you want it.

Apple Intelligence is integrated into your iPhone through on-device processing. So it’s aware of your personal information without collecting your personal information. With Private Cloud Compute, it can draw on larger, Apple-designed server-based models, running on Apple silicon, to handle more complex requests while protecting your privacy.
The Passwords app makes it easier to access account passwords, passkeys, Wi‑Fi passwords, and two-factor authentication codes stored securely on your device or synced with iCloud Keychain.
Private Browsing in Safari locks browsing windows when they’re not being used, blocks known trackers from loading on pages, and removes tracking added to URLs as you browse.

Switching from Android to iPhone is simple.
Switching from Android to iPhone is simple.
Transfer your data in a few easy steps.

Simply download the Move to iOS app on your Android phone to securely transfer the stuff you care about most to your iPhone — contacts, messages, WhatsApp content, photos, videos, email accounts, favorite apps, call history, and more.
Learn more about the Move to iOS app

Messages lets you reply with a quick emoji, create Memoji, and pay a friend for pizza. RCS (Rich Communication Services) messaging brings richer media and delivery and read receipts for those who don’t use iMessage. * And you can keep your conversations going on apps such as WhatsApp and WeChat.

Apple engineers design our hardware and software together for a totally seamless experience. Want to connect your new AirPods to your iPhone? It’s a simple one‑tap setup. Want to share photos or contacts with friends nearby? AirDrop lists their names onscreen, so you can choose with a tap.
Help is just a call or chat away.

There are lots of ways to reach someone if you have questions. Call a Specialist, chat with someone online, go into an Apple Store, or use the Apple Support app. And the Tips app will help you get the most out of your iPhone over time.
iPhone holds its value longer than other smartphones.
iPhone holds its value longer than other smartphones.

iPhone is protected by Ceramic Shield, which is tougher than any smartphone glass or glass ceramic. Our latest iPhone models have Ceramic Shield 2 on the front, with better scratch resistance, 1 and Ceramic Shield on the back for added durability. Little spill? No biggie — iPhone stands up to splashes from everyday liquids like water, coffee, and soda. 2
Regular iOS updates keep your iPhone feeling new for years to come. Just turn on automatic updates, and your iPhone stays current with the latest features and security.

The vapor-cooled A20 Pro chip is the most powerful and efficient chip ever in an iPhone. And because it’s purpose-built for AI, with Neural Accelerators and a new Dual 16-core Neural Engine, A20 Pro supercharges everything from image generation to intelligent camera features.
Picture your best photos and videos.
Picture your best photos and videos.

The advanced cameras in iPhone automatically capture phenomenal photos with great detail and color. And on iPhone Duo, Smart Take uses on-device AI to detect when people are posed and automatically takes the picture.

With variable aperture on the 48MP Fusion Main camera, iPhone 18 Pro offers our best-ever camera system for pros and creators. It automatically adjusts depth of field for exceptional low-light photos and video. And with new Pro controls and Photographic Styles 3 to adjust texture and grain, you’ll have even more creative range.

Get pro-level videos using 4K 120 fps Dolby Vision on iPhone Duo and the latest Pro models. Use Action mode to steady shaky scenes as you shoot. Remove unwanted background noise from voices and music with Audio Mix. Add Cinematic mode effects, even after you shoot. Quickly access camera tools with Camera Control. And with the Center Stage front camera, use Dual Capture to record on front and rear cameras simultaneously. 6
Helpful in all the right places.
Helpful in all the right places.

Your AI assistant, Siri AI is powered by Apple Intelligence and is more helpful than ever. 3 Get more done every day with richer answers, natural conversations, and a new, dedicated app. It’s truly helpful AI that’s centered around you and your needs — integrated into your apps, grounded in your context, and private at every step.
Siri AI is rolling out in English. Usage limits may apply.
Start a visual search with the Shutter button.
Siri mode in Camera and Visual Intelligence let you search, ask questions, and take action based on what’s around you with just a tap. 4
Easy-to-use AI editing tools like Spatial Reframing let you adjust a shot after it’s been taken. You can expand your photos with the Extend tool. And remove objects with the enhanced Clean Up tool. 5
Designed with the earth in mind.
Designed with the earth in mind.
We’re significantly expanding the use of key recycled metals in iPhone batteries, magnets, and circuit boards. Case in point: All our batteries are now made from 100 percent recycled cobalt. 7
All iPhone packaging is made of paper that is 100 percent fiber based and can be easily recycled.

When you’re ready to buy a new iPhone, you can trade in your current iPhone or Android device and apply any credit toward your purchase. If your device isn’t eligible for credit, we’ll recycle it for free.
Our disassembly robots — Daisy, Dave, and Taz — recover crucial materials like gold, cobalt, tungsten, and rare earth elements so they can be recycled and used again.
Our stores, offices, and data centers are already carbon neutral. By 2030, we aim to reach carbon neutrality for our global footprint.
Your data. Just where you want it.
Your data. Just where you want it.

Apple Intelligence is integrated into your iPhone through on-device processing. So it’s aware of your personal information without collecting your personal information. With Private Cloud Compute, it can draw on larger, Apple-designed server-based models, running on Apple silicon, to handle more complex requests while protecting your privacy.
The Passwords app makes it easier to access account passwords, passkeys, Wi‑Fi passwords, and two-factor authentication codes stored securely on your device or synced with iCloud Keychain.
Private Browsing in Safari locks browsing windows when they’re not being used, blocks known trackers from loading on pages, and removes tracking added to URLs as you browse.

Switching from Android to iPhone is simple.
Transfer your data in a few easy steps.

Simply download the Move to iOS app on your Android phone to securely transfer the stuff you care about most to your iPhone — contacts, messages, WhatsApp content, photos, videos, email accounts, favorite apps, call history, and more.

Messages lets you reply with a quick emoji, create Memoji, and pay a friend for pizza. RCS (Rich Communication Services) messaging brings richer media and delivery and read receipts for those who don’t use iMessage. * And you can keep your conversations going on apps such as WhatsApp and WeChat.

Apple engineers design our hardware and software together for a totally seamless experience. Want to connect your new AirPods to your iPhone? It’s a simple one‑tap setup. Want to share photos or contacts with friends nearby? AirDrop lists their names onscreen, so you can choose with a tap.
Help is just a call or chat away.

There are lots of ways to reach someone if you have questions. Call a Specialist, chat with someone online, go into an Apple Store, or use the Apple Support app. And the Tips app will help you get the most out of your iPhone over time.
iPhone holds its value longer than other smartphones.
iPhone holds its value longer than other smartphones.

iPhone is protected by Ceramic Shield, which is tougher than any smartphone glass or glass ceramic. Our latest iPhone models have Ceramic Shield 2 on the front, with better scratch resistance, 1 and Ceramic Shield on the back for added durability. Little spill? No biggie — iPhone stands up to splashes from everyday liquids like water, coffee, and soda. 2
Regular iOS updates keep your iPhone feeling new for years to come. Just turn on automatic updates, and your iPhone stays current with the latest features and security.

The vapor-cooled A20 Pro chip is the most powerful and efficient chip ever in an iPhone. And because it’s purpose-built for AI, with Neural Accelerators and a new Dual 16-core Neural Engine, A20 Pro supercharges everything from image generation to intelligent camera features.
Picture your best photos and videos.
Picture your best photos and videos.

The advanced cameras in iPhone automatically capture phenomenal photos with great detail and color. And on iPhone Duo, Smart Take uses on-device AI to detect when people are posed and automatically takes the picture.

With variable aperture on the 48MP Fusion Main camera, iPhone 18 Pro offers our best-ever camera system for pros and creators. It automatically adjusts depth of field for exceptional low-light photos and video. And with new Pro controls and Photographic Styles 3 to adjust texture and grain, you’ll have even more creative range.

Get pro-level videos using 4K 120 fps Dolby Vision on iPhone Duo and the latest Pro models. Use Action mode to steady shaky scenes as you shoot. And with the Center Stage front camera, use Dual Capture to record on front and rear cameras simultaneously. 6
Helpful in all the right places.
Helpful in all the right places.

Designed with the earth in mind.
Designed with the earth in mind.
We’re significantly expanding the use of key recycled metals in iPhone batteries, magnets, and circuit boards. Case in point: All our batteries are now made from 100 percent recycled cobalt. 7
All iPhone packaging is made of paper that is 100 percent fiber based and can be easily recycled.

When you’re ready to buy a new iPhone, you can trade in your current iPhone or Android device and apply any credit toward your purchase. If your device isn’t eligible for credit, we’ll recycle it for free.
Our disassembly robots — Daisy, Dave, and Taz — recover crucial materials like gold, cobalt, tungsten, and rare earth elements so they can be recycled and used again.
Our stores, offices, and data centers are already carbon neutral. By 2030, we aim to reach carbon neutrality for our global footprint.

Blackview BV4800 Pro is made for adventurous users who need practical durability in daily life and outdoors. Its 6.56-inch display, Smart-K BOX speaker, 5180mAh battery, and 5W reverse charging support entertainment, communication, and backup power on the go. With Unisoc T606, 4GB RAM, 128GB ROM, up to 8GB RAM expansion, 1TB storage expansion, 8MP front camera, 16MP + 2MP rear cameras, IP68/IP69K, MIL-STD-810H, Glove Mode, NFC, and four-system navigation, it stays ready.
At Blackview, we believe great technology should go beyond impressive specs. It should fit real life, solve real problems, and stay reliable when it matters most.
Blackview began with rugged phones built for tough environments. Today, we offer a wider ecosystem of smart devices, including smartphones, tablets, laptops, smartwatches, audio products, and more.
Across every category, our focus stays the same: durable quality, practical innovation, and accessible pricing. We design products that feel dependable from day one.
We understand what customers value most: smooth performance, long-lasting reliability, useful features, and technology that makes everyday life easier without unnecessary cost.
That’s why Blackview puts real attention into product testing, user experience, and features that bring meaningful value to work, travel, creation, outdoor exploration, and daily connection.
Blackview is made for people who want technology they can trust: smart, capable devices built to keep up with modern life.
Reliable by design. Practical by nature. Made for real life.
Blackview BV4800 Pro 6.56-Inch Unisoc T606 Octa-core 4+128GB 5180mAh 4G Rugged Phone
Built Tough for the Adventurous Spirit

With a large 6.56-inch screen and a solid, calm look, the intrepid BV4800 Pro boasts an 83% screen-to-body ratio for excellent picture presentation. Compared to phones of the same size, it offers a larger screen and more comfortable visual effects for your eyes.
Feel every beat and every note with BV4800 Pro's Smart-K BOX speaker, taking your audio enjoyment to unparalleled heights with its powerful sound.

The 5180mAh battery in the BV4800 Pro extends your joy throughout the day and beyond. The high-capacity battery reliably meets your productivity needs, whether for work or study, without frequently requiring a recharge.
Keep your devices alive on the go with the BV4800 Pro’s reverse charging – your ultimate travel companion.

Whether in high or low light, the 8MP front camera delivers excellent image quality and performance, capturing all the tiny details you might miss in daily life. All your delightful moments and spectacular views can be clearly recorded with the 16MP and 2MP rear cameras, preserving fresh memories.

Always overwhelmed by cluttered backgrounds when taking photos? Portrait mode helps solve this annoying problem. It keeps the face clear while blurring the background, resulting in a photo that highlights the main subject.
The panoramic mode on the BV4800 Pro surpasses the field of view of regular lenses, allowing you to capture a wider perspective and obtain more complete and comprehensive photos.
Turning on HDR mode can help you capture spectacular landscape photos by balancing the light and dark areas, making them more vibrant.
The Beauty Mode on BV4800 Pro effectively blurs blemishes and restores natural skin texture while enhancing overall skin appearance.

Easily record your day-to-day adventures, scenic views, and life’s unique moments. The up to 1080P resolution makes sure that every video you share with your family and friends looks strikingly real and immersive.

Armed with an octa-core Unisoc T606 chip using sophisticated 12nm technology, BV4800 Pro strikes a perfect balance between performance and energy consumption, ensuring longer battery life and surpassing previous endurance limits.
Up to 12GB RAM=4GB RAM+ Up to 8GB RAM Expansion

Insufficient memory storage will only make your phone sluggish when trying to switch to chat software while playing games like Genshin Impact. However, having 4GB of RAM coupled with 8GB of virtual RAM allows you to switch back and forth smoothly between multiple applications.
128GB ROM + Up to 1TB TF Card Expansion

On top of the 128GB ROM memory, BV4800 Pro can also be equipped with up to a 1TB TF card to store action-packed games, diverse applications, colorful photos, and brilliant clips. Everything you desire can be stored on this incredibly large storage card.
As a rugged phone, the BV4800 Pro reflects professionalism in its robust structure for withstanding harsh weather conditions and special occasions.
To further enhance adaptability to harsh environments and improve performance for challenging outdoor adventures, BV4800 Pro has upgraded from MIL-STD-810G to MIL-STD-810H.

With the high protection standards of IP68 and IP69K waterproof ratings, BV4800 Pro provides complete protection against water ingress and will not be damaged even when immersed in water under certain pressure, demonstrating its durability and ruggedness.
Waterproof Up to 1.5 Meters Deep for 30 Minutes*.
Say goodbye to frozen fingers with BV4800 Pro's glove-friendly screen. Easily use your phone while skiing, hiking, or braving the rain, all without the hassle of removing your gloves.

What makes the GT 30 Pro 5G perfect for gaming? The GT 30 Pro 5G is an esports-ready beast featuring segment-first dedicated GT Gaming Triggers. Combined with a 144Hz refresh rate and 120FPS gaming support, it provides professional-level control and ultra-fluid gameplay. Q. Which chipset is used in the GT 30 Pro 5G? The smartphone is powered by the incredibly robust MediaTek Dimensity 8350 Ultimate processor. Fabricated on a 4nm process, this octa-core CPU and Mali-G615 GPU deliver elite performance for high-end gaming and heavy multitasking. Q. Does the GT 30 Pro 5G have customizable lighting? Yes, the GT 30 Pro 5G features customizable Mecha Lights on the back panel. You can personalize these LEDs to react dynamically to notifications, charging, and gaming events. Q. What are the charging speeds for the GT 30 Pro 5G? The 5500mAh battery supports rapid 45W wired FastCharge and 30W wireless charging. It also supports 10W reverse wired charging, allowing you to quickly juice up your wireless earbuds or smartwatches on the go. Q. Does the GT 30 Pro 5G support bypass charging? Yes, it supports smart Bypass Charging. This essential gaming feature routes power directly to the motherboard instead of the battery while gaming, drastically reducing heat generation and preserving long-term battery health. Q. How durable is the screen on the GT 30 Pro 5G? The brilliant AMOLED display is heavily protected by premium Corning Gorilla Glass 7i, making it highly resistant to accidental drops and scratches. The phone itself also features an IP64 dust and splash resistance rating. This sleek design makes the device highly ergonomic, lightweight, and very comfortable to hold or slide into your pocket. Q. Is the Infinix Smart 20 water and dust resistant? This provides an extra layer of biometric security, allowing you to unlock your smartphone quickly and securely with a single touch. Q. Which operating system does the Smart 20 run? This provides a clean, user-friendly software experience packed with intuitive features and modern privacy controls. features: Conheça o Smartphone Motorola Moto g06 64GB
Smartphone Motorola Moto g06 64GB 4GB RAM + 8GB Ram Boost, Camera 50MP com AI Bateria de 5200 mAh Tela 6.9" - Azul Marinho
A maior tela da categoria ¹

O moto g06 tem a maior tela ¹ da categoria , com 6,9″, resolução HD+ e imagem superbrilhante. O smartphone também tem o sistema de áudio mais avançado da sua faixa de preço ⁹ . Os alto-falantes estéreo com tecnologia Dolby Atmos ® entregam o dobro de potência nos graves ¹⁰ .
Tela que responde ao toque mesmo molhada

Com a tecnologia Smart Water Touch do celular moto g06, a tela responde ao toque e aos gestos mesmo quando está molhada . Ideal para trocar a música da festa na piscina ou chamar uma corrida de aplicativo na chuva, sem perrengue.

Feito com material superior, o moto g06 é feito para durar. Com a certificação IP64 ² , você não precisa se preocupar com respingos e derramamentos. E o dia a dia fica mais tranquilo sabendo que a tela está protegida com o vidro Corning ® Gorilla ® Glass 3 .
Circule, destaque ou toque em uma imagem ou texto para obter resultados da Pesquisa do Google . Descubra na hora o que você quiser sem precisar trocar de app.
Até 49 horas de duração da bateria ⁴

Conte com a bateria de 5200 mAh para ouvir música por mais tempo, passar horas e horas em videochamadas com os amigos e maratonar suas séries preferidas até o último episódio⁴. Ela é feita para durar em todos os sentidos , mantendo 80% da capacidade mesmo após anos de uso e 1000 ciclos de recarga ⁵ .
Selfies com alta resolução Frontal 8 MP

Tire fotos lindas e vibrantes em qualquer luz usando a câmera avançada com sensor de 50 MP e tecnologia Quad Pixel . Conte com os recursos de inteligência artificial para melhorar automaticamente seus retratos e fotos com pouca luz.

Com o sensor de 50 MP , seus cliques saem lindos e cheios de detalhes. Já a tecnologia Quad Pixel garante mais sensibilidade em situações de pouca luz para suas fotos ficarem mais nítidas e vibrantes, seja de dia ou de noite.
Tire selfies prontas para as redes sociais e compartilhe na hora. Ative o Retoque Facial para ajustar as fotos automaticamente, assim você e a galera ficam bem na foto.

Agilize sua vida multitarefa com até 4 GB RAM + 8 GB de RAM Boost Inteligente⁸ e a velocidade turbinada do processador octa-core. Faça o que você precisa sem desacelerar. O processador MediaTek Helio G81 Extreme entrega alta velocidade sem sacrificar a duração da bateria para você curtir suas séries por streaming, conversar por videochamada e tirar fotos até cansar.

1 [A maior tela] A partir de medições internas, com base de referência em telefones do mesmo segmento (preço entre R$ 899 e R$ 1.199) lançados no Brasil até julho de 2025. A tecnologia Smart Water Touch possibilita utilizar a tela mesmo durante exposição à respingos de água. Aparelho não resistente à água/imersão.

5 [Vida útil prolongada da bateria] Com base em testes internos em laboratório sob condições controladas, simulando hábitos diários de recarga dos usuários. A vida útil real da bateria varia e depende de padrões pessoais de uso, métodos de carregamento, temperatura e outros fatores. O desempenho da bateria tende a diminuir ao longo do tempo.

7 [Cartão microSD] A expansão da memória pode ser feita através de um cartão de memória padrão microSD, não incluso. O sistema operacional e/ou aplicativos podem ter limitações quanto à instalação, gravação ou cópia de conteúdos no cartão de memória. Em alguns aparelhos, o segundo cartão SIM e o cartão de memória microSD não podem ser usados simultaneamente. microSD é uma marca comercial da SD-3C, LLC.

9 [Faixa de preço] Com base na combinação de alto-falantes estéreo com Graves fortes e Dolby Atmos®, não encontrada em telefones do mesmo segmento (preço entre R$ 899 e R$ 1.199) lançados no Brasil até julho de 2025.
10 [Graves fortes] Com base em uma comparação interna entre a potência de graves dos alto-falantes do moto g06 e de seu antecessor, o moto g05.

[4] Design e qualidade estrutural: padrões militares de durabilidade Os padrões MIL-SPEC do departamento militar dos EUA estabelecem metodologias para avaliar as limitações do dispositivo em condições ambientais extremas controladas em laboratório. A Motorola segue determinados procedimentos e categorias do padrão MIL-STD-810H para testar dispositivos em relação a condições físicas e ambientais de modo a avaliar a durabilidade. Esses testes não garantem nenhum desempenho nessas condições no futuro. O motorola edge 60 foi testado em 16 categorias e 14 procedimentos MIL-STD-810H para provar sua resistência. A garantia padrão da Motorola não cobre abusos, como os que ocorrem nos testes MIL-STD 810H. [5] Proteção IP69 & IP68 contra água Testado em laboratório sob condições controladas, o telefone é resistente a água, respingos e poeira com as classificações IP68 e IP69 (IEC 60529). O telefone suporta imersão em água doce até 1,5 metro de profundidade por 30 minutos e tem proteção contra jatos fortes de água quente por até 30 segundos. A exposição a condições fora desses parâmetros não está coberta pela garantia. A resistência diminui devido ao desgaste normal. O dispositivo não foi projetado para funcionar quando estiver submerso. Não o exponha a outros líquidos. Não tente carregar o telefone se ele estiver molhado. O projeto prevê proteção contra a entrada de sólidos de qualquer tamanho. Não é à prova d'água. [6] Bateria que dura até 40 horas Todas as declarações sobre a duração da bateria são aproximadas e têm como base o usuário regular, conforme testes com um perfil de uso misto (que inclui tempo de uso e em espera) sob condições de rede ideais. O desempenho real da bateria varia e depende de muitos fatores, como intensidade do sinal, configurações do dispositivo e da rede, temperatura, condição da bateria e padrões de uso. [7] Capacidade da bateria (comum e certificada) A capacidade comum é de 5200 mAh. Esse valor é a capacidade média estimada de um lote de baterias conforme testes internos, representando o desempenho esperado em condições normais. A capacidade certificada é de 5100 mAh. Essa é a capacidade mínima garantida da bateria em condições controladas. [8] Carregamento: bateria para o dia inteiro em 8 minutos Usuários regulares podem obter até 12 horas de duração da bateria com 8 minutos de carga. O nível de bateria deve estar consideravelmente baixo, o Carregamento acelerado deve estar ativado e o ritmo de carregamento diminui ao longo da recarga. [9] Armazenamento O armazenamento interno disponível para o usuário, de maneira similar a outros equipamentos como computadores, é inferior à capacidade física total devido a diversos fatores como formatação (organização da estrutura lógica do componente para uso pelo sistema operacional), espaço ocupado pelo sistema operacional necessário para funcionamento do smartphone, aplicativos, conteúdos, dados instalados, bem como espaço reservado necessário para atualizações do sistema operacional. [11] RAM Boost Inteligente RAM Boost Inteligente (Otimização da RAM) é um recurso que cria memória RAM virtual especificamente para aumentar a capacidade do smartphone de manter vários aplicativos abertos simultaneamente. Requer o uso de parte do armazenamento interno, diminuindo o espaço disponível em um terço da memória RAM virtual pretendida. Função ativada por padrão, que pode ser desativada pelo usuário. A memória RAM e espaço de armazenamento interno disponíveis são menores devido ao sistema operacional, software e outras funções, e podem mudar de acordo com atualizações de software. Ou seja, o RAM Boost Inteligente é um recurso opcional de expansão virtual de memória, que pode ser ativado ou desativado pelo usuário e utiliza parte do armazenamento interno disponível. A tela AMOLED de 6,7” com resolução 1.5K, HDR10+ e taxa de 120 Hz oferece imagens nítidas e fluidas para vídeos, redes sociais e games. O novo smartphone Edge 70 também traz bateria de 4800 mAh com carregamento TurboPower de 68W, câmera traseira dupla de 50 MP + 50 MP e câmera frontal de 50 MP , ideal para fotos de alta qualidade, vídeos em 4K e selfies detalhadas. O Motorola Edge 70 512GB foi lançado por R$5.499, enquanto o Motorola Edge 70 256GB chegou ao mercado por R$4.499. Mas fique de olho na nossa página de ofertas e na de cupons ativos da Motorola para garantir celulares com desconto . Motorola Edge 70 especificações? O Motorola Edge 70 é um smartphone ultrafino e resistente, feito de alumínio aeroespacial, protegido por vidro Gorilla® Glass 7i e certificações IP69/IP68, além de padrão militar, garantindo durabilidade contra impactos, poeira e água. É o único celular ultrafino com três câmeras traseiras de 50 MP e traz a maior bateria da categoria, com 4.800 mAh. Saiba mais! O Motorola Edge 70 é à prova d 'água? O novo smartphone Motorola Edge 70 é resistente à água graças ao IP69/IP68. Essa certificação garante resistência superior a poeira, sujeira, areia, água em alta pressão e imersão em água doce por até 1,5m por 30 minutos. Qual é o processador do novo Motorola Edge 70? O Motorola Edge 70 vem equipado com o Snapdragon 7 Gen 4, um processador moderno e potente que garante ótimo desempenho para jogos, apps e multitarefa, sem comprometer a eficiência de energia. A tela do Motorola Edge 70 é boa? Sim! O novo celular Motorola Edge 70 traz uma tela Extreme AMOLED de 6,7' com resolução Super HD e certificação Pantone Validated, oferecendo brilho intenso, cores muito mais fiéis e taxa de atualização de 120 Hz para imagens fluidas. Quanto tempo dura a bateria do Motorola Edge 70? A bateria do Motorola Edge 70 tem 4.800 mAh com tecnologia de silício-carbono, oferecendo autonomia para o dia todo com uso intenso. Além disso, conta com recarga turbo de 68 W e carregamento sem fio de 15 W, reduzindo o tempo de espera O Motorola Edge 70 grava em 4K? Sim, o Motorola Edge 70 grava vídeos em 4K com suas câmeras de 50 MP, garantindo imagens nítidas e detalhadas em qualquer situação. Qual a diferença entre o Motorola Edge 70 e o Motorola Edge 70 Fusion? O Motorola Edge 70 e o Motorola Edge 70 Fusion têm processadores, câmeras e baterias diferentes. O Motorola Edge 70 traz Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 com 12 GB de RAM + 12 GB Boost, armazenamento de 512GB, bateria de 4800 mAh e câmeras traseiras duplas de 50 MP + 50 MP ultra‑wide/macro, além de frontal de 50 MP e gravação em 4K. Já o Edge 70 Fusion usa Snapdragon 7s Gen 3, 8 GB de RAM + 16 GB Boost, 256 GB de armazenamento, câmera traseira principal de 50 MP e ultra‑wide/macro de 13 MP, além de frontal de 32 MP e maior bateria de 5.200 mAh. Qual a diferença entre o Motorola Edge 70 e o Motorola Edge 70 Fusion Plus? O Motorola Edge 70 usa Snapdragon 7 Gen 4, 12 GB de RAM + 12 GB Boost, 512GB de armazenamento, câmeras traseiras duplas de 50 MP e bateria de 4.800 mAh. Já o Edge 70 Fusion Plus traz Snapdragon 7s Gen 4, 256GB de armazenamento, bateria maior de 5.200 mAh e foco reforçado na fotografia, com ultra‑wide/macro de 50 MP, zoom óptico de 3x e câmera frontal de 50 MP, oferecendo mais versatilidade. Como todas as câmeras gravam em 4K a 60 fps e possuem calibração de cores Pantone™ Validated, você garante fotos, stories e vídeos com tons de pele reais, nitidez profissional e excelente qualidade mesmo em ambientes escuros, ideal para as redes sociais. O Motorola Edge 70 512GB é uma boa opção para quem viaja muito e quer guardar conteúdos sem se preocupar com espaço? Com certeza! O Motorola Edge 70 conta com incríveis 512 GB de armazenamento, permitindo que você guarde milhares de fotos, músicas e vídeos em alta resolução das suas viagens sem precisar apagar arquivos com frequência. Além de ter muito espaço, ele é o companheiro perfeito de aventuras: Suporta variações extremas de temperatura Tem proteção nível militar (MIL-STD-810H) contra quedas Certificação IP68/IP69 que protege contra água. O Motorola Edge 70 512GB é bom para jogos mobile e para assistir a filmes e séries? Sim, o Motorola Edge 70 512GB entrega uma experiência de entretenimento imersiva. 120º de abertura 4x mais perto ULTRAWIDE 8 MP

Câmera com IA e vídeos em 4K

Tire fotos mesmo em ambientes com pouca luz usando a câmera de 50 MP com IA do novo celular moto g35 5G. Você também pode gravar vídeos supernítidos em 4K e tirar selfies de milhões com a câmera frontal de 16 MP.
Todo mundo pode ficar bem na foto. Com a câmera de 50 MP com IA e tecnologia Quad Pixel desse smartphone, seus cliques saem lindos e cheios de detalhes.
Grave vídeos supernítidos em 4K com esse celular Motorola. Com 4x mais resolução do que os vídeos em 1080p, eles ficam perfeitos para telas grandes.

Mude para o modo Night Vision em ambientes com pouquíssima luz para revelar mais detalhes no escuro.
Tela protegida com Corning®️ Gorilla®️ Glass 3
Tenha mais tranquilidade no dia a dia com a proteção do Corning®️ Gorilla®️ Glass 3. Com maior resistência a danos, o vidro é capaz de suportar vários níveis de pressão, cortes profundos e arranhões.

O Color Boost ajusta as cores da tela de acordo com a iluminação do ambiente, melhorando a visibilidade da tela e a qualidade das cores. As áreas escuras se tornam mais claras, enquanto as cores ficam mais vibrantes.
Está com a mão molhada e precisa usar o telefone? Não se preocupe.

Com a tecnologia Smart Water Touch³, a tela do celular responde ao toque ou gesto de deslizar mesmo se estiver com um pouco de água. Assim, você não passa perrengue enquanto cuida da playlist da festa na piscina ou chama uma corrida de aplicativo na chuva
eSIM: mais praticidade e segurança para seu celular

O eSIM é um chip digital que substitui o SIM Card removível. Além da praticidade de poder ter diferentes eSIMs instalados no seu aparelho, essa nova tecnologia impede que seu chip seja removido caso você perca seu telefone. Quais as vantagens do eSIM?
Ativar o eSIM no seu aparelho é muito fácil. Você só precisa do seu aparelho e de uma conexão WiFi. Veja se seu celular Motorola é compatível e siga o passo a passo que preparamos para você.

features: From HMD - makers of Nokia phones

A quality conversation starts with a quality phone. Nokia 110 4G boasts premium design that comes through in every touch. And, with HD voice support,¹ you’ll hear and be heard clearly on your calls. Listen to your favorite tracks on the go with the MP3 player and MicroSD card slot.² Listening, talking or taking photos, the long-lasting battery will see you through.
Featuring a textured finish for a fabulous look and feel.
HD voice calling¹ supported by 4G. It will feel as if you’re in the same room.
Snap with the rear camera² and share with 4G or Bluetooth.
Easy to see and simple to use
Increase the font size and zoom-in the interface on the bright, clear display.
Feels as fabulous as it looks
With its nano pattern finish, it’s scratch resistant and feels great in your palm. What’s more, it boasts an unmistakably classic design with sleek, modern touches.
Staying in touch has never been easier. From its tactile keypad to its ease-of-use features, Nokia 110 4G makes conversations easy for anyone.
Never cut a good conversation short

Nokia 110 4G delivers hours of talk time thanks to its 1450 mAh³ battery. On standby, it can go for weeks, so you’re virtually always reachable. Plus, the battery saver feature takes you even further between charges.
Tune in to FM radio with or without a headset. Want your own playlists? With the MP3 player² and MicroSD card slot, you can take your favorite songs with you on the go.
Nokia 110 4G comes prepared with Bluetooth connectivity, a built-in torch, camera, an Opera Mini internet browser and pre-loaded games.

features: Spójrz na wszystko z innej perspektywy

Windows 11 tworzy spokojne, kreatywne miejsce do pracy i zabawy, w którym możesz realizować swoje pasje dzięki nowym funkcjom i narzędziom. Od odmłodzonego menu Start po nowe sposoby łączenia się z ulubionymi osobami, kanałami aktualności, grami i treściami.
Wykorzystaj niesamowitą wydajność procesorów AMD Ryzen z serii 7000. Ciesz się niesamowitą szybkością, dłuższym czasem pracy na baterii i zawsze wysoką wydajnością pracy, zabawy i tworzenia.

Zanurz się w realistycznym świecie wirtualnym dzięki procesorowi graficznemu NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ z serii 40. Został on oparty na niezwykle wydajnej architekturze NVIDIA Ada Lovelace, obsługuje śledzenie promieni i rozgrywkę z ultrawysoką liczbą klatek przy niskich opóźnieniach – wrażenia są naprawdę niesamowite.
DDR5 to najnowsza pamięć RAM do laptopów, cechująca się większą szybkością, wyższą przepustowością i niższym zużyciem energii niż DDR4. Jest idealna do gier, edycji wideo i tworzenia treści.
Dyski SSD PCIe Gen4 NVMe oferują prędkości odczytu i zapisu do 7 GB/s, czyli 5-krotnie większe niż dyski SSD w standardzie SATA. Są idealne do gier i wymagających zadań.

ASUS Antibacterial Guard 99% bacterial inhibition. Your health safeguarded. The surface of any laptop harbors thousands of potentially harmful bacteria. In fact, Antibacterial Guard has been scientifically proven 7 to inhibit the growth of bacteria 8 by more than 99% over a 24-hour period, ensuring the surfaces 9 of your laptop clean and sanitary for longer and reducing the spread of potentially harmful bacteria via contact. Learn more about ASUS Antibacterial Guard ASUS Antibacterial Guard 99% EFFECTIVE ISO-CERTIFIED PROTECTION ANTIBACTERIAL SILVER IONS Without ASUS Antibacterial Guard a sample of 10,000 bacterial cells grew to 28,000. Performing the same test with Antibacterial Guard saw the count reduced to just 16 — a growth restriction of more than 99%. Our test adheres to ISO 22196 8 , and involves both E. coli and Staphylococcus aureus. All bacteria can be classified by Gram staining into Gram positive or Gram negative, named after bacteriologist Hans Christian Gram. The ISO 22196 8 test defines Staphylococcus aureus and E. coli respectively as Gram positive and Gram negative. Many industries choose these two bacteria as test targets — and it is these that are tested against ASUS Antibacterial Guard. The ASUS Antibacterial Guard treatment consists of positively-charged silver ions and is durable enough for at least three years of normal usage 10 . Household cleaning products and agents such as alcohol wipes and soap water won’t easily wear away the silver-ion surface treatment, ensuring ASUS Antibacterial Guard’s long-lasting bacterial-inhibiting effect. M.2 SSDs are incredibly small and versatile, but the traditional mounting system involves tiny standoffs and screws that can be difficult to manipulate. ROG solved this problem with Q-Latch, a system that first debuted on our award-winning desktop motherboards. Q-Latch uses a simple, tool-less plastic hinge to securely retain your M.2 SSDs, no screwdriver required.

Take on even the largest projects with confidence ultra-fast PCIe Gen 4 storage. With raw throughput up to 7000MB/s, massive files and detailed game worlds will load in the blink of an eye. Both SSD slots feature our incredibly simple and tool-less Q-latch system, no standoffs or tiny screws required. For those looking to leverage even faster storage speeds, both SSD slots are PCIe Gen 5 ready. * The maximum read/write speed of Gen 5 SSDs may vary

The Strix G16 is upgradable to 32GB of DDR5 6400MHz RAM, offering incredible gaming and multitasking performance. Whether you bought a machine straight from the factory or upgraded the RAM yourself, the G16 is a gaming and content creation powerhouse. Go ahead — keep all those tabs open.

We’ve also equipped the Strix G16 with dual Thunderbolt™ 5 ports, which offers the latest in high bandwidth connectivity, up to 3X compared to Thunderbolt™ 4. With a diverse ecosystem of devices and peripherals compatible over USB-C, including support for power delivery, high-resolution display output, and support for the latest docking stations, Thunderbolt™ 5 is the easiest way to turn your G16 into a true battlestation.

We’ve used vapor chambers in our high-end ROG machines before, but the component inside the heart of the 2025 Strix G16 is truly special. We’ve designed a vapor chamber with different layers to more accurately match the layout of the motherboard, for maximum contact on the CPU and GPU. We also pushed the vapor chamber all the way to the rear of the chassis, sandwiching it between the upper and lower heatsinks to further optimize heat dissipation.

The entire rear portion of the Strix G16 is dedicated to its full-width heatsink. The upper and lower sections are built from 0.1mm thick copper fins, for a total surface area of 169388 mm². This sandwiched design uses all available space for the densely packed fins, giving the G16 ultra-efficient thermal performance without increasing bulk.

Our cutting-edge Tri-Fan Technology directs air though precisely calculated cutouts in the chassis, sending airflow directly towards internal components to keep them cool in all conditions. A third auxiliary fan sends additional heat from the GPU and VRAM directly to the heatsinks, keeping the machine cool during long video renders or gaming sessions.
The new rear facing exhaust, redesigned vapor chamber, and 2nd Gen Arc Flow Fans allowed us to bring the operating volume in Turbo Mode down from last generation.
The Strix G16’s heatsink features ultra-thin 0.1mm copper fins, providing the perfect balance between airflow and density to keep heat dissipation optimal.

Extended gaming sessions can heat up internal components and make the keyboard warm to the touch. The Strix G16 boasts the largest airflow cutouts we’ve ever added to a laptop, which allows the fans to draw in fresh air from above and through the keyboard deck. This keeps your fingers cool during marathon gaming sessions, while also improving overall system airflow.

The ROG Strix G16 features a dust filter on its intake vents. Dust and fibers can collect inside the machine, trapping heat and causing degraded performance over time. A filter helps keep dust out, allowing the CPU and GPU to breathe easier for years of smooth and stable operation. *Internal testing in a simulated dusty environment.

Our Silent, Performance, and Turbo modes are just the beginning. Scenario Profiles allow your system to automatically switch between these modes based on the application you're running, alongside other vital system settings. Switch between lighting configurations automatically, disable the Windows key and touchpad during games, and automate to your heart's content. Armoury Crate makes adjustments in an instant to best fit the task at hand.

This year, we even added two layers of Ambient Contrast Ratio (ACR) film to the display, which reduces reflections and enhances contrast, ensuring the image stays punchy, vivid, and accurate even when viewed at an angle or in bright rooms. This machine doesn't just perform at a high level – it draws you into the visuals, with colors so realistic it’s as if you were right in the middle of the action.

Scene to scene, frame to frame, Dolby Vision makes media look better. The technology improves on standard 4K high dynamic range (HDR) video, dynamically adjusting visuals to make every image in front of you richer, brighter, and livelier. Creators can film and edit their streams, videos, and other content in a format commonly used by industry professionals.

Each IPS-level display is factory-calibrated to ensure that colors are accurate to the Pantone ® palette. Artists, designers, and content creators can add high-quality content to their portfolios and enjoy richer gaming visuals all on the same machine.

While the sRGB color space is the standard for most digital visuals, it only represents about 75% of the DCI-P3 spectrum used for professional filmmaking. Displays with complete DCI-P3 coverage offer a wide color gamut for more vibrant images, letting you see films and other media exactly the way they were meant to be experienced.

Nothing breaks in-game immersion like stuttering and tearing. GPUs render frames at variable rates, but displays usually refresh at a constant clip, so they can get out of sync, causing visible hitching and artifacts that pull you out of the action. With Adaptive Sync, the refresh rate of the display synchronizes with the GPU’s frame rate to eliminate visual tearing, minimize stuttering, and reduce input lag. Get ready to experience gameplay that looks and feels more natural than ever.

Displays emit light across a broad spectrum that unfortunately includes some less desirable wavelengths. Our Nebula Display protects your eyes by reducing blue light before it leaves the screen, preventing eyestrain during long gaming or content creation sessions.

We know you aren’t always gaming, so we’ve increased the size of the touchpad by 36% from the previous generation for effortless scrolling even when your mouse is tucked away. A larger touchpad also makes multi-touch inputs easier, giving you a smoother experience with the machine even when you’re just browsing the web.

Dedicated gaming hotkeys sit just above the left side of the keyboard for quick access to volume, mic mute, operating modes, and Armoury Crate. They are also fully customizable, and can be programmed to launch apps, set as a function key, or used as a macro. The Strix G16 has all the tools you need for victory.

Exclusive ROG Overstroke technology registers keypresses earlier in the stroke, enabling a more responsive experience for serious gaming and work. Triggering earlier means faster, effortless inputs with greater accuracy.

Our advanced Two-Way AI Noise Cancelation technology runs on the CPU, which frees up the GPU to hit higher FPS. It works with any input device and also with downstream connections, letting you remove noise from both your own mic input and from incoming feeds. Noise-canceling settings can even be customized per program, filtering specific apps like voice chat without affecting game audio you want to remain untouched.

Two tweeters and two woofers powered by Smart Amp offer richer sound with 2.8x more volume, 3x more powerful bass, and up to 3x the dynamic range of alternatives. This quad-speaker setup delivers immersive surround sound optimized by Dolby Atmos technology to deliver balanced, multidimensional audio across the full spectrum without losing clarity or detail.

Descrição do produto O poderoso notebook gamer ASUS TUF Gaming F16 une performance de alto nível com design robusto e estiloso . Feito para gamers exigentes e profissionais que buscam tecnologia de ponta, este computador transforma a experiência de jogo e trabalho, com processador Intel® Core™ 5 210H de alto desempenho e gráficos dedicados NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 4050 . Há ainda tela imersiva com bordas finas, fácil atualização de memória RAM e SSD, e resistência de nível militar para aguentar qualquer tranco. DESEMPENHO E REALISMO SEM LIMITES No coração do ASUS TUF Gaming F16 está o poderoso processador Intel® Core™ 5 210H (Série 2) de alto desempenho. Desde os mais pesados softwares profissionais até os jogos mais exigentes rodam com agilidade e sem interrupções. Com suporte da placa de vídeo dedicada NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 4050 , os jogos ganham mais realismo e fluidez. As tecnologias MUX Switch e NVIDIA® Advanced Optimus aprimoram não só os efeitos visuais, como também o gerenciamento de energia para gerar gráficos impressionantes e altas taxas de quadros por segundo. TELA IMERSIVA E RÁPIDA O ASUS TUF Gaming F16 conta com tela nível IPS de 16 polegadas , resolução Full HD+ (1.920 x 1.200 pixels) e proporção 16:10, que entrega imagens vibrantes e realistas com tempo de resposta de somente 3 milissegundos.  As bordas superfinas maximizam a área de visualização, resultando em 90% de proporção entre a tela e o corpo do notebook, para cada detalhe ser apreciado com clareza e profundidade. Além disso, a alta taxa de atualização de 144 Hz garante maior fluidez às imagens que aparecem na tela, eliminando qualquer borrão e mantendo a vantagem competitiva mesmo nos momentos mais intensos da jogatina. ATUALIZAÇÃO FÁCIL E CONECTIVIDADE COMPLETA Pensando na personalização e no futuro, o ASUS TUF Gaming F16 foi desenvolvido para facilitar upgrades. Com slots duplos de memória RAM offboard e dois espaços para SSD PCIe® 4.0 disponíveis, você tem total flexibilidade para expandir as configurações conforme suas necessidades. Para manter você sempre conectado, o notebook gamer ainda oferece vasta gama de portas para dispositivos , incluindo USB Tipo-A e Tipo-C, HDMI 2.1, porta de rede RJ-45, conector combo de áudio de 3,5 mm e entrada de energia dedicada (DC-in). Enquanto isso, o Wi-Fi 6 e Bluetooth 5.3 garantem transferências de arquivos, assim como conexões sem fio rápidas e estáveis para jogos online, streaming e trabalho remoto. CONFIABILIDADE E REFRIGERAÇÃO AVANÇADA O ASUS TUF Gaming F16 é robusto, com construção certificada pelo exigente padrão MIL-STD-810H de resistência de nível militar . Essa validação garante que o notebook foi submetido a testes rigorosos de durabilidade que simulam desafios do uso diário, como vibrações e impactos, sem perdas de desempenho ou danos ao chassi. Para ainda mais confiabilidade, o sistema de resfriamento avançado utiliza ventoinhas Arc Flow™ duplas, com até 4 saídas de ar e 5 tubos de calor. Esse sofisticado mecanismo de dissipação de calor mantém a temperatura ideal, mesmo durante sessões intensas de jogos, evitando superaquecimento e garantindo que o hardware opere sempre no potencial máximo. ÁUDIO POTENTE E TECLADO RETROILUMINADO Com sistema de som imersivo, o ASUS TUF Gaming F16 ostenta certificados de áudio Dolby Atmos e Hi-Res de alta qualidade, além de cancelamento de ruído bidirecional por Inteligência Artificial. Esses recursos proporcionam experiência sonora envolvente, em que cada explosão, diálogo e efeito sonoro é ouvido com clareza e profundidade. Por fim, o teclado incorpora retroiluminação RGB de uma zona, assim como a tecla Copilot dedicada para fácil acesso ao assistente de IA do Windows. Aproveite o desempenho monstro e a imersão total do ASUS TUF Gaming F16! Optimal click ratio: Engineered to perfection The feel of a keyboard depends on the crucial ratio between the peak force (also known as the actuation force) and the contact force. Peak force occurs when you press down on the key and reach the maximum force that the key’s underlying rubber dome can withstand without deflecting. Contact force occurs when the bottom of the key touches the circuit board to trigger an electronic signal, which in turn generates the action appropriate to the key. To achieve the most natural feel for a keyboard, ASUS keyboard experts have scientifically determined that the optimal ergonomic click ratio for a key is between 45-60%. These forces are precisely measured and tuned using the ASUS-designed rubber domes beneath the keys. Resistentes al agua y el polvo con certificación IP68

¿Sudor, lluvia, agua salada y arena? Suena divertido. Los auriculares JBL Endurance Pace cuentan con una clasificación IP68 de impermeabilidad y resistencia al polvo, por lo que pueden soportarlo todo. Por no mencionar las altas temperaturas, la humedad o las caídas desde grandes alturas.

Dos micrófonos de haz conformado captan y transmiten tu voz mientras cancelan el ruido ambiental. Para que puedas hacer llamadas claras y nítidas incluso cuando corras por un ajetreado parque en un día fresco.

Entrena durante más de una semana sin tener que cargarlos. Puedes disfrutar de hasta 10 horas de música o pasar todo un día al teléfono. JBL Endurance Pace es compatible con Fast Pair de Google y Swift Pair de Microsoft. Se emparejan inmediatamente con tus dispositivos Android y con tu ordenador Microsoft con un solo toque, y permanecen emparejados.

Con Google Audio Switch, los auriculares cambian fácilmente de un dispositivo Android Bluetooth® a otro. Waterproof and dustproof in-ear true wireless sport headphones with JBL Pure Bass Sound
Adaptive Noise Cancelling with Smart Ambient

Enjoy the soundtrack of your life. Four noise-sensing mics minimize distractions and maximize audio quality, while Smart Ambient keeps you fully aware of your surroundings and helps you talk with the people around you without taking out your headphones. Use the JBL Headphones app to set your custom levels.

Sweat, rain, salt water, and sand? Sounds like a great time. JBL Endurance Peak 4 earbuds carry an IP68 waterproof and dustproof rating, so they can withstand it all. Not to mention high temperatures, high humidity, or long-distance drops.

You might even forget you're wearing them. JBL OvalTubes™ with TwistLock™ stay in your ears all day without discomfort. The liquid silicone ear hook with memory wire is comfortable and adaptable to different sizes.
JBL Pure Bass with Spatial Sound

Enjoy rich, clear JBL Pure Bass sound from our 10mm dynamic driver, delivering powerful stereo sound with deep bass for an immersive audio experience. Customize your sound to the way you are with Personi-fi 3.0. Take a quick earing test and adapt your audio to your personal features.

Three mics per ear effectively capture your voice while suppressing noise from other sources. Meanwhile, the beamforming algorithm minimizes unwanted ambient noise, making your authentic voice more intelligible. The windproof design significantly reduces distortion from air friction and gives you a crystal-clear call experience—even in the middle of an outdoor run on a breezy day.
Up to 48 hours total playback, plus speed charge

Get up to 12 hours from the earbuds and three more full charges in the charging case* before you need to plug them in again. And if that's not enough, 10 minutes gets you four more hours**. *With ANC off. 8 hours plus 24 hours with ANC on **Charging cable not included
Customize on the go with the JBL Headphones app

Use the JBL Headphones app to match your sound to your workout. Choose one of the preset modes for light, medium, or intense activity—or customize your own. And when your workout is done, chill out and recharge in Relax Mode by choosing one of five peaceful sounds, like gentle ocean waves or a crackling wood fire.
Always remember where your headphones are. A lanyard hole in the charging case makes them easy to carry around, so you're ready for a quick workout—every time.
Multi-Point Connection + Fast Pair enabled by Google

JBL Endurance Peak 4 come enabled with Fast Pair by Google, so they immediately pair with your Android devices with a single tap. Pair your earbuds with two Bluetooth® devices and then switch effortlessly from one to the other. So if you're using an exercise video on your tablet, you won't miss a call on your mobile phone.
Google Finder and Google Audio Switch

With Google Finder you can locate your misplaced earbuds with Android devices. Seamlessly switch from one Android Bluetooth® device to another with Google Audio Switch. Jump from a video on your tablet to a call on your mobile phone, and never miss a moment.

meta: Usá los controles del Smart Charging Case de los auriculares JBL Live Buds 3 True Wireless para controlar la cancelación de ruido y audio de alta resolución sin tener que usar tu celular. Ajusta el volumen y el ecualizador, controla tu música, responde llamadas, y hasta consultá mensajes. Además, disfrutá del increíble sonido JBL Signature con la mejor tecnología True Adaptive Noise Cancelling para eliminar las distracciones. El sonido JBL Spatial hace que las películas y la música sean realmente envolventes. Y si tienes que responder una llamada, los 6 micrófonos garantizan una calidad de sonido perfecta incluso en los entornos más ruidosos. Todo esto, además de una carga de 40 horas: 10 horas en los auriculares y otras 30 en la funda, y se pueden cargar de forma inalámbrica.

Audio inalámbrico de alta resolución con el sonido JBL Signature

Los transductores dinámicos de 10 mm de los JBL Live Buds 3 incorporan el sonido JBL Signature. Cada transductor está perfectamente ajustado para ofrecer graves profundos, medios equilibrados y agudos refinados, todo ello a cualquier nivel de volumen. El sonido JBL Spatial te hace sentir como si estuvieras en un concierto, ya que el sonido proviene prácticamente de todas partes a tu alrededor.
Práctica Smart Charging Case™ para un control sin necesidad de aplicaciones

Puedes personalizar todos los aspectos de tus auriculares JBL Live Buds 3 con la pantalla táctil de 1,45 pulgadas de tu Smart Charging Case™. La pantalla te ofrece un control total del sonido en cualquier dispositivo —portátil, televisor, smartphone o tableta portátil—, sin necesidad de acceder a la aplicación JBL en tu smartphone.
True Adaptive Noise Cancelling con control personalizado

Disfruta de 10 horas de reproducción, más otras 30 en el estuche de carga.* ¿Necesitas recargar más rápido? 10 minutos en un cable de carga USB tipo-C te proporcionarán otras cuatro horas de reproducción. También puedes recargarlos de forma inalámbrica. (*con ANC desactivado)

Los seis micrófonos de haz reducen la interferencia del viento y el ruido para que siempre te escuchen alto y claro. Un ecualizador de voz y un optimizador de nivel de voz te ofrecen un control total no solo sobre cómo te escuchan los demás, sino también sobre lo alto que escuchas tú a los demás.
Cambia sin esfuerzo de un dispositivo Bluetooth a otro, de modo que si estás viendo un vídeo en tu tableta portátil, no perderás una llamada en tu móvil.

Con el servicio Google Finder, si alguna vez pierdes tus auriculares, una red de más de 3 millones de dispositivos Android te ayudará a encontrarlos automáticamente. Con Google Audio Switch, los auriculares cambian de conexión sin problemas de un dispositivo Bluetooth® Android a otro. Salta de un vídeo en tu tableta portátil a una llamada en tu teléfono móvil y no te pierdas ni un momento.
Desde la playa hasta el sendero para bicicletas, los auriculares JBL Live Buds 3 son resistentes al agua para todas tus aventuras al aire libre.

Escucha y siente cada nota de tu lista de reproducción. Da forma a tu audio para que coincida con tu perfil de escucha personal con herramientas de personalización interactivas que utilizan información precisa sobre ti y tus preferencias para proporcionar la curva de sonido exacta que mejor se adapte a ti.

Disfruta de música clara y dinámica mientras dejas el canal auditivo abierto, para que siempre tengas una idea de lo que sucede a tu alrededor. El ajuste preciso de los auriculares JBL Sense Lite elimina las fugas de sonido, por lo que tus conversaciones siempre serán privadas y confidenciales.

Los controladores dinámicos ligeros, eficientes y altamente sensibles de 18 x 11 mm ofrecen un sonido fluido y equilibrado. Mientras tanto, el algoritmo de refuerzo de graves adaptativo ajusta automáticamente los graves en función del volumen de la música, para disfrutar de un sonido mejorado y dinámico con profundidad y riqueza.
Diseñados para ofrecer comodidad durante todo el día

Los oídos son tan únicos como las huellas dactilares. Por lo tanto, los auriculares JBL Sense Lite están diseñados para proporcionar un ángulo de escucha perfecto y ofrecer una baja fuga de sonido a oídos de todas las formas y tamaños. Los auriculares JBL Sense Lite están fabricados con silicona líquida duradera y ultrasuave combinada con cable de memoria. Y el diseño equilibrado distribuye el peso de manera uniforme, para que resulten cómodos durante todo el día.

Dos micrófonos de formación de haces por auricular capturan eficazmente tu voz mientras suprimen el ruido de otras fuentes. Mientras tanto, el algoritmo de formación de haces minimiza el ruido ambiental no deseado, haciendo que el efecto de voz sea más inteligible y auténtico. El diseño hidrodinámico resistente al viento reduce significativamente la distorsión por fricción del aire y ofrece una experiencia de llamada nítida incluso en exteriores.

Con hasta 8 horas de tiempo de reproducción en los auriculares y otros 24 en el estuche, incluso el usuario más asiduo podrá disfrutar de ellos casi una semana entre cargas. Y si alguna vez necesitas una recarga rápida, 10 minutos con el cargador te darán otras tres horas.
Encuentra tu propio sonido con el EQ de 10 bandas. O cambia los controles táctiles intuitivos de cada auricular para manejar tu música y llamadas como quieras.
No dejes que un poco de lluvia te impida correr a diario. Estos auriculares IP54 resistentes al agua y al polvo están diseñados para plantar cara a los elementos.
Abre el estuche y tus auriculares se emparejarán automáticamente con tu dispositivo Android. Con Dual Connect, puedes usar ambos auriculares de botón juntos o solo uno individualmente.

Vincula primero tus auriculares JBL Sense Lite con hasta dos dispositivos Bluetooth® al mismo tiempo y cambia después sin esfuerzo de uno a otro. Así que si estás en medio de un vídeo en tu tableta portátil, no te perderás ninguna llamada en tu móvil.

El diseño único de gancho para la oreja dividido y ajustable de los auriculares JBL Sense Pro te ofrece un ajuste cómodo y seguro adaptado a tus orejas, además de una calidad de llamada nítida y clara.
features: Te has apuntado con éxito para recibir avisos sobre el producto. Mandaremos un correo a cuando vuelva a estar disponible.
